nodeData.topic: Session 01 · Glories of the Holy Name
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj opens Sri Harinama-cintamani: Mahaprabhu asks Haridasa Thakura, the lowest by birth, to reveal the glories of the holy name, and Haridasa agrees in deep humility to speak whatever the Lord puts in his heart. He explains Krishna as the master of his three energies, the two destinies of the jivas, and the Lord's descent as his name for Kali-yuga. Questions cover the Viraja river, why not everyone received Mahaprabhu's love, and why faith matters. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: A dialogue recorded by Bhaktivinoda Thakura
children.note:
Maharaj introduces the book: a conversation between Caitanya Mahaprabhu and Haridasa Thakura, written down by Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakura. Mahaprabhu sometimes speaks and sometimes makes his devotees speak while he listens.

🎙 Maharaj at 06:40 (auto-transcript): “The book Harinam Chintamani is a discussion with Chaitanya Mahaprabhu and Haridash Thakur. Chaitanya Mahaprabhu uses devotees to speak what he hears and sometimes he speaks devotees here.”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 06:40

children.note:
Nothing here is Bhaktivinoda Thakura's own invention; he is reporting what took place between the Lord and his devotee. — “So it is Shilabhakti Vinod Thakur reporting what has happened.”

🎙 Maharaj at 08:17 (auto-transcript): “And Shilabhakti Vinod Thakur has recorded everything. So it is Shilabhakti Vinod Thakur reporting what has happened. All Glories to Gadhadhara and Gauranga, to the life of Janava Nityananda Prabhu, All Glories to Sita and Advaita, to Srivas and all the devotees.”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 08:17

children.note:
The text sets the scene at Nilacala, the Blue Mountain, where Jagannatha lives in a wooden form. Maharaj notes that if you go to Puri now you will see neither a mountain nor anything blue; it was there in that age.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:50 (auto-transcript): “Now if you go to Jagannath Puri You will not see Mountain Not even blue When you say Blue Mountain, for that time, there was a Blue Mountain, Nilachal, Blue Mountain. That place is called Purshottam Chetra, Purshottam Chetra. It's a tunnel by Kuntra World, it's a spiritual world.”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 10:50

children.topic: Mahaprabhu gives freely, but only the best
children.note:
Like a desire tree, Mahaprabhu gives love of God without asking who is who. Yet he is very careful that what he gives is only the highest quality, pure love for God. — “A desired tree does not consider who is who.”

🎙 Maharaj at 14:20 (auto-transcript): “A desired tree does not consider who is who. He simply gives freely. Chaitanya Mahabharata was distributing love of Godhead exactly like that, freely to everybody. As he desired three. Although he was disputing Godhead freely, freely like a desire tree, But Chaitanya…”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 14:20

children.topic: Speaking and hearing are both blissful
children.note:
So he chose particular devotees to speak while he listened. One can relish Krishna-katha by speaking it or by hearing it. — “Both ways are blissful.”

🎙 Maharaj at 16:00 (auto-transcript): “One can take pleasure by speaking about Krishna Katha or take pleasure in listening to Krishna Katha. Both ways are blissful. In this way, through Ramananda Rai's mouth, he taught the concept of rasa, the concept of rasa through Ramananda Rai.”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 16:00

children.note:
Through Ramananda Raya's mouth the Lord taught the science of rasa.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:32 (auto-transcript): “In this way, through Ramananda Rai's mouth, he taught the concept of rasa, the concept of rasa through Ramananda Rai. Through the mouth of Sarabama Bhattacharya, he taught the real principle of liberation. Liberation are of different categories.”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 16:32

children.note:
Through Sarvabhauma Bhattacarya he taught what real liberation is. Maharaj lists ordinary 'liberations': the hungry man freed when he eats, the poor man when he gets work, the angry man when his enemy falls. Real liberation is transcending the three modes.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:56 (auto-transcript): “Through the mouth of Sarabama Bhattacharya, he taught the real principle of liberation. Liberation are of different categories. If one is liberated, a person who is tortured by hunger becomes liberated when he eats his”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 16:56

children.note:
Rupa Gosvami gives detailed measurements of Krishna's form — eyes, ears, height, chest — something nobody else had described.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:31 (auto-transcript): “Rupa Goswami measured Krishna's body from head to toe. Rupa Goswami has a measurement. Rupa Goswami ji, Bhagawan Krishna's body of the body can't be able to use the body of Krishna's body. How is everyone? How big is it? Nobody has ever described Krishna's body. Measure…”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 20:31

children.note:
Through Haridasa Thakura the Lord chose to reveal the full glories of the holy name.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:31 (auto-transcript): “Through the mouth of Harida Sekhura, Shri Chaitama Mahaprabhu taught the full glories of the Holy Name. So one day after”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 21:31

children.topic: The easiest way out of material existence
children.note:
After bathing in the ocean, Mahaprabhu asks Haridasa how souls can easily be freed. Maharaj asks the audience what the Lord wants to teach, and answers: the holy name is the easiest, simplest and most powerful process.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:59 (auto-transcript): “Chhita Mahaprabhu wants to teach us the easiest way to do what? To become liberated from material existence. The easiest way for liberation.”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 22:59

children.topic: Ecstasy before a word is spoken
children.note:
Even before Haridasa begins to speak about the name, his body is already trembling in love and tears pour from his eyes.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:44 (auto-transcript): “He is going to speak about the Holy Name. Even before speaking, his body is already shaking in place. Haidash Thakur, as he listened to this person Haidash Thakur, before he said his body, before he said his body, in love, in love, before he said his body. Haidash Thakur…”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 24:44

children.topic: The lowest asked to speak the highest
children.note:
Maharaj points to the depth of the Lord's lila: he does not ask Prakasananda Sarasvati or Sarvabhauma, but an unlettered man, outcaste by birth, to speak on the highest subject.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:11 (auto-transcript): “He's going to ask the lowest person in the society, to speak about the highest thing in the world. He didn't ask Prakashananda Saraswati to speak. He didn't ask Sarabha Bhattacharya to speak, he asked illiterate to speak about the highest”

children.note:
Haridasa says the Lord has put his question to someone unfit, so how can an answer come? Still he does not refuse; the Lord's feet are his only shelter.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:12 (auto-transcript): “Hardaash Thakur said you have asked a question to an unfit person. How will you get an answer? It's a mistake. Hardaash said, I'm here, I'm here, I'm here, I'm here, I'm here, I'm here, what are you doing? Well, Hardaash Thakur did not abandon speaking. But then, Hardaash…”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 28:12

children.topic: The scriptures live in his heart
children.note:
Mahaprabhu replies that Haridasa speaks this way out of humility. By social standards he may be nobody, but the scriptures live in his heart; one need only become a devotee. — “One does not need to be a scholar”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:54 (auto-transcript): “Chaitanya Mahabhu told Haridas, out of humility, we are speaking like this. Yes, you are not nothing, you are absolutely nothing, you have no education, you are nobody in a society according to social orders, militias, yabanas, they have no place. Yes, this may be your…”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 30:54

children.note:
For our own affairs we must weigh good and bad. But what comes from Krishna has no failure or success; it is absolute. So Haridasa decides to say whatever the Lord puts in his heart, as it is. — “I will present it as it is.”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:00 (auto-transcript): “For our own, we have to consider good and bad. but for Krishna there is no consideration about good or bad. Nothing like failure or success. Everything is absolute. So Haradas Chakura is teaching Krishna is going to speak to me it is not my own. Therefore there is no question of”

children.note:
Krishna is the independent, conscious Supreme Truth, the vibhu or master, and his energies are his vaibhava, his opulent expressions. They are never independent of him.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:14 (auto-transcript): “Krishna is an independent, principal, conscious entity. Independent, principal, conscious entity. And the energies are his attributes. He has attributes, his qualities. Krishna is the power of his powers, his powers, his powers, his powers. He can never be independent.…”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 37:14

children.note:
Maharaj asks: when you say fire, what are you looking at? Heat and light come with it. Fire never exists empty of its attributes, and Krishna is never without his energies. — “When you say fire, what are you looking at?”

🎙 Maharaj at 38:51 (auto-transcript): “For example, if you say fire, what are you looking at? Fire. When you say fire, what are you looking at? Yes, here it will be isma, it will be in the house. Lights. Prakash. Yes, yes. Right? So when you say fire, you cannot just say fire, empty fire. It has attributes, the…”

children.note: He cites Bhagavad-gita 9.4, where Krishna says everything rests in him while he remains distinct from it.

children.note:
The energies fall into three: the spiritual manifestation (antaranga), the material (bahiranga) and the jivas (tatastha). Maharaj links the book's terms to the names devotees already know.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:12 (auto-transcript): “These energies of Krishna are grouped into three. Chit Vajbhava or spiritual manifestations coming from Krishna's spiritual potency. that is called we're familiar with antaranga sakti we are familiar with that antaranga sakti”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 43:12

children.note:
Some souls turn to Krishna and stay eternally liberated with him; others turn away toward Maya's realm and wander through good and bad births in the material universe.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:52 (auto-transcript): “Two types of Jeevas. One. Those Jeevas who resort to Krishna to attain that bliss remain as liberated souls eternally associated with Krishna. And one who foolish him, who selfishly desire to enter the neighboring abode of Maya.”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 50:52

children.topic: The Lord comes as his name
children.note:
The Lord constantly thinks about our liberation, so for the souls of Kali-yuga he descends with his own name and gives the process of nama-sankirtana, the chief path to love of Krishna. — “The Lord constantly think about our survival, our liberation.”

🎙 Maharaj at 53:01 (auto-transcript): “The Lord constantly think about our survival, our liberation. The Lord constantly think about that. Therefore, He planned ways how to get us out of the miserable condition of mental resistance. Therefore, thinking of the wealth of the Jeevas in Kali Yuga, the Lord has…”

children.topic: Practice and perfection look the same
children.note:
Hearing and chanting are the practice, sadhana, and they remain the activity at perfection too. When we reach prema we keep chanting and hearing. — “When we attain Preyema Bhakti, we will continue the chanting and hearing.”

🎙 Maharaj at 57:41 (auto-transcript): “Even when, although chanting and hearing it is sadhana, at the stage of sadhya, it also remains the same principle. When we attain Preyema Bhakti, we will continue the chanting and hearing. Arada Sekura continued.”

orbit.ref: Session 01 | Glories of the Holy Name (Apr 14, 2025) · 57:41

children.note:
Maharaj asks us to take this blessing seriously: whoever takes shelter of Krishna, his devotees and devotional service receives the full effect of the name. The name is a touchstone that fulfils every desire. — “Three items here.”

🎙 Maharaj at 61:39 (auto-transcript): “One who takes refuge in Krishna, I'm repeating, is a tetanus. One who takes shelter of Krishna. Krishna's devotees. Devotional service. Three items here. children.topic: Q1 · What is the Viraja river?
children.note:
A devotee asks what lies on either side of the Viraja.

🎙 Question from the floor at 63:46 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev, my question is that you told about Achit Vaibhav and I want to know under that that what is Virja River and what is on one side of Virja River and the other on other side. children.note:

nodeData.topic: Session 02 · Taking Up Chanting of the Holy Name
nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Mahaprabhu praises Haridasa Thakura's faith and character and asks him to speak; Maharaj shows that faith, not birth or wealth, is the qualification and that character is the best preaching, illustrated by the story of the snake charmer and the pretender. Haridasa describes three levels of Vaishnava, the name as cintamani, the oneness of the name and Krishna, and the path from namabhasa to the pure name through faith and service to a pure devotee. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: Embrace in prema; the hearer's part
children.note:
Chapter 2 begins with Haridasa weeping and Mahaprabhu embracing him tightly in prema before they sit down to continue.

🎙 Maharaj at 06:31 (auto-transcript): “in the ecstasy of Prima He wept, he wept. He just cried in Prema.”

orbit.ref: Session 02 | Taking Up Chanting of the Holy Name (Apr 15, 2025) · 06:31

children.note:
Maharaj notes that Mahaprabhu himself shows how to hear: a good listener draws out the speaker by showing eagerness and by remarks that show the words are meaningful.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:16 (auto-transcript): “They hear us who stimulate the speaker by statement which shows our eagerness to hear. The speaker, the hearer, the hearer will stimulate the speaker by showing the eagerness and the expression that it is meaningful.”

orbit.ref: Session 02 | Taking Up Chanting of the Holy Name (Apr 15, 2025) · 08:16

children.topic: Not won by birth or wealth

maps.title: Harinama Cintamani · Session 03 · Namabhasa (Part 1)

nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Haridasa begins on namabhasa: the holy name is like the sun, always pure, but clouds of ignorance and anarthas keep the chanter from seeing it, just as a diabetic cannot taste sugar. Maharaj explains the three kinds of ignorance, the four clouds (illusion, material craving, weakness of heart, offences), and how shelter of a bona fide guru gives sambandha, abhidheya and prayojana. In questions he urges steady practice and says growing desire to chant is a sign of progress. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Mahaprabhu wants namabhasa understood, because then chanting becomes pure. The name is powerful like the sun and dispels all darkness, but a cloud or mist can block it from view.

🎙 Maharaj at 06:28 (auto-transcript): “The holy name of Lord Krishna is very, very powerful like the sun. Therefore, it will destroy, dispel all ignorance, all illusion, all darkness. Sometimes a cloud or mist”

A cloud does not cover the sun; it covers the viewer. The name is always pure and perfect; the cloud of namabhasa covers the chanter, so some see its full manifestation and others do not. — “It's not covering the sun.”

🎙 Maharaj at 07:30 (auto-transcript): “A cloud cover the sun from the via. It's not covering the sun. It is covering the via. The via may not see the sun. The sun is always there. But the via's eyes are covered. Similarly, the holy name is always pure, transcendental, perfect. But the cloud of the namabas, the…”

Sugar is always sweet, but someone with diabetes cannot taste it. The fault is not in the sugar, and not in the name; it lies with us, the chanters. — “the problem is not with the holy name”

🎙 Maharaj at 12:21 (auto-transcript): “Just like sugar is always sweet, but the person who is suffering from diabetes will not taste is sweet.”

Maharaj observes that nobody leaves tasty food half-eaten to go and do something else. So why do some not finish their rounds from morning to night? Because the taste is missing. — “The food is tasty.”

🎙 Maharaj at 14:16 (auto-transcript): “Till now, we have not seen a person who is releasing the food and keeping it aside to go and do something else and come back. Right? It will continue until you finish it.”

Ignorance, namabhasa and namaparadha seriously interfere with chanting, so Haridasa now examines them carefully.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:59 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, ignorance, namabhaj or namaparad, they are serious interference and therefore you have to look at this very carefully. So Haridash Thakur is going to talk about ignorance, about the holy name.”

Haridasa says ignorance about the name is of three kinds, and each leads into darkness.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:04 (auto-transcript): “Haridash Thakur has said ignorance is of three types. three, three types. Ignorance are three, three categories. Haidash Thakur is saying that this abhidya is in three categories. If one does not know the true spiritual nature of the holy name which one has accepted, this…”

children.topic: Not knowing who the name is
children.note:
The first ignorance is not knowing the true spiritual nature of the name one has accepted.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:46 (auto-transcript): “Ignorance of the name, who is Naam Prabhu. If one does not know who is Naam, this is ignorance and it will lead us to darkness. So, number one is what? Ignorance of who the Holy Name is.”

The second is not knowing Krishna's position, which leads to demigod worship. Maharaj warns that this may seem simple but it is not.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:58 (auto-transcript): “worship So secondly, ignorance is what? Who does not know who Krishna is? Who don't know Krishna's position? This may seem simple, but it is not simple. The ignorance is one who does not know who one is, that we are an infinitesimal part of Krishna and does not take shelter…”

The third is not knowing that we are tiny parts of Krishna, and so not taking shelter of him.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:40 (auto-transcript): “The ignorance is one who does not know who one is, that we are an infinitesimal part of Krishna and does not take shelter of Krishna, is in darkness. Three ignorances”

Every devotee says aham brahmasmi, I am spirit. But Maharaj asks whether our activities show it. One who truly knows this closes his senses to sense gratification and opens them to Krishna in devotional service. — “do we behave like Brahman?”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:52 (auto-transcript): “Every devotee knows that I am Brahma as me. But when we look into our activities, do we behave like Brahman? No. I am Brahmasmi, but he is not doing anything about Brahman,”

One who knows he is Krishna's eternal servant is fully absorbed and his service is steady, without distraction.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:37 (auto-transcript): “Such a person knows Aham Brahmasmi. That person's devotional service is very, very steady, progressively, and is fixed in that, and no destruction.”

children.topic: No detours into karma or jnana
children.note:
Knowing Krishna as the Supreme Person, one never turns to karma or jnana; knowing the name is Krishna, one takes full shelter of the name.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:00 (auto-transcript): “One who knows Krishna is the supreme person, but he would never go into karma, he would never go into gyan, he would be fully fixed in bhakti. One who knows also that”

Maharaj points to Haridasa Thakura, Bhaktivinoda Thakura, the Gosvamis and Srila Prabhupada, and to the Pandavas: whatever difficulty came simply pushed them further toward Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:24 (auto-transcript): “That is what we saw what Harida said. Shri La Haidash Thakur Ji ke Jeewan mein Sri La Bhakti Vinod Thakur Ji And Goswami Goswamiyok ke Jeewan mein Shri La Prabhupad Shri La Prabhupad Ji ke Jeewan mein See You see the Difficulties Sra Pakar went through”

He recalls an acarya's appeal: give this lifetime to Krishna even if it means constant insult or threat, for love of God is worth any price and ends all our troubles.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:21 (auto-transcript): “Solanay Bhaktitamhara says, I request all of you to give your time, this lifetime to Krishna. Even if it requires constant insult, give this life to Krishna. Even if it requires constant threat, give this life to Krishna because the throne of Godhead won't paying any price.”

The opposite of ignorance is knowledge: Krishna is the Lord, the jivas are his servants, and the material world is an unconscious by-product. Simple, says Maharaj.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:46 (auto-transcript): “Opposite of ignorance is knowledge. Knowledge would destroy ignorance. So, Haridya Sekhara said knowledge means knowing Krishna is the Lord, the living entities are the servants, and the material world is an unconscious gross manifestation of the byproduct of the Lord. This…”

Bhakti is a science with formulas. Clearly understanding Krishna's position, our position, the name and the material world is one formula for pure chanting. — “So this is one of the formulas for pure Chanti.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:40 (auto-transcript): “We have been saying that Bhakti is a Saiyan. and it has a formula. So this is one of the formulas for pure Chanti.”

Having discussed tattva-vibhrama, illusion about the truth, Haridasa lists the other anarthas that cover the sun of the name.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:10 (auto-transcript): “The next thing to discuss are narrators. Anarthas, you have mentioned Tatva Vibhrama, now we are looking at Asat Trishnas, Asat Trishnas. Asatrishna means we have taste for other things, not Krishna. Asatrishna. We have taste for temperating, not Krishna. It is called Asatrishna.”

Asat-trsna means a taste for things other than Krishna. It grows from the first problem: not knowing Krishna, the soul, the name and matter, we seek the gods and sense pleasure.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:44 (auto-transcript): “Asatrishna means we have taste for other things, not Krishna. Asatrishna. We have taste for temperating, not Krishna. It is called Asatrishna. Why Ashat Krishna? Why there is Ashat Krishna?”
These four Mahaprabhu calls durdaiva, misfortune, in the Siksastakam verse where he laments that he has no attraction for the name.

Craving for objects here, for heavenly pleasure later, for mystic powers and for impersonal liberation — in none of them is Krishna, so the name tastes dull. — “There is no Krishna inside.”

🎙 Maharaj at 44:23 (auto-transcript): “There is no Krishna inside this world. There is no Krishna inside. Therefore, they make our desire for chanting the holy name, our taste for selling the holy name, not song. The holy name will not be tasty in our tongue so the third item is weakness of the heart”

Attachment to things unrelated to Krishna, deceit, envy of others' spiritual progress, and the race for fame and position — all clouds.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:48 (auto-transcript): “in our tongue so the third item is weakness of the heart It means what? Attachment for three full things all related to Krishna.”

Offences against the name, against Krishna in service, against devotees, the holy dhama, other living beings and prasadam.

maps.title: Harinama Cintamani · Session 04 · Namabhasa (Part 2)

nodeData.note: SB 6.2.14 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj stresses our only two businesses, chanting and devotional service, and why results stay small while we remain in namabhasa. Yet namabhasa is very good: it destroys sins, surpasses yoga, saved Ajamila in seconds, and SB 6.2.14 shows its four kinds — though it is no licence, and without care it turns into offence. Questions cover bad association, the line between namabhasa and namaparadha, attentive chanting and why unoffered food lacks prasadam's potency. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Maharaj opens: we have only two businesses in this world, chanting the holy name and devotional service. Practised now, they mature into prema-nama and prema-seva.

🎙 Maharaj at 03:57 (auto-transcript): “We only have two business in this world.”

We chant and serve yet the result is not what we expect. The acaryas have explained our difficulties and their solutions; as long as we stay in namabhasa, the result stays small. — “As long as we remain in Nama Bhās, the result will be very, very small.”

🎙 Maharaj at 06:00 (auto-transcript): “We have been chanting Hare Krishna Mantra and we have been doing devotional service and at the same time you also notice that the result is not as we are expecting. Therefore, our acharyas have explained all our difficulties and they have also given all the solutions to all…”

Recapping the four anarthas, Maharaj stresses that without knowledge of our relationship with Krishna the anarthas remain and chanting in namabhasa will not give its proper result.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:23 (auto-transcript): “So, sambandha gyan is very, very potent, necessary. If sambandha gyan is not received, our anarchists will remain, and by chanting in Nama Abbas, we will not get the required result of chanting.”

children.topic: No tears? The reason is offence
children.note:
He cites Krishnadasa Kaviraja Gosvami in Caitanya-caritamrta: if one chants and no tears come, no hair stands on end, the only reason is offence.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:42 (auto-transcript): “Krishna, as Kavala Goswami mentioned this very clearly in Chetam Chati with that. If one is chanting, the tears are not coming, the head is not standing on end, we are not shivering. The only reason is Aparad. the cloud is there just as if the cloud is there we can't see the…”

As with the cloud and the sun, the name is always present; our anarthas cover our eyes.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:17 (auto-transcript): “the cloud is there just as if the cloud is there we can't see the sun clearly but that does not mean that the sun is not there the sun is there but the cloud covering our eyes we don't see the Similarly, the cloud of our narrators, number of hearts, recover all from…”

Maharaj turns to the bright side: if we keep chanting constantly, even namabhasa has the power to free us from offences and bring us to prema. It is the chief of pious acts and gradually gives faith. — “Namabhas is very good.”

🎙 Maharaj at 16:13 (auto-transcript): “Namabhas is very good. Namabhas is very good. Why Namabhas is good? Because if we constantly maintain our chanting, if we maintain our chanting constantly, even Namabas has the power to release us from all offenses and take us to the professional stage.”

Namabhasa is higher than yoga, sacrifice, varnasrama rules and austerity. Yoga may or may not succeed; namabhasa, maintained, will surely lead to prema. — “Yoga, you may succeed, you may not succeed.”

🎙 Maharaj at 18:12 (auto-transcript): “Nama Bhasa is considered higher than the activities of yoga. Sacrifice. Varna Ashram rules. Austerities. because it will lead to the part of your bhakti. In other words,”

Other processes lead to bhakti only when mixed with some devotional act. A visitor handed a flower to offer at Prabhupada's guru-puja does not know what he has done, yet in under a minute he is connected to bhakti.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:10 (auto-transcript): “For example, we see in our temples, people come to the temple. And Prabhupada Gurupuja is going on. They give them flower to offer to the Prabhupada. He doesn't know what he has done. But that has connected that person to bhakti. How many minutes does he take to offer flower…”

Chanting even in namabhasa destroys sins, removes the faults of Kali-yuga, brings peace and drives away ghosts and evil influences; even residents of hell can be freed.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:06 (auto-transcript): “Yes, the effect of chanting in Namabhas. What do we gain by that effect of chanting in Namabhas? By chanting in Namabhas, all sinful effects are destroyed and one cannot attain liberation from material world. All the fate of Kali Yuga are overcome.”

Maharaj asks how many yogis have seen the Supersoul, and after how many years. Ajamila called 'Narayana' for his son and the Vishnudutas appeared at once — five seconds — and closed the door of hell. Namabhasa, not the pure name.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:02 (auto-transcript): “How many Yogis have seen this? Vishnu, super soul. How many yogis? Yes, how many yogis have seen super soul? How long did you take Ajayamila to see Vishnu? How many minutes? How many minutes? Vishnu Dutra's appear before. Ten years? How many minutes?”

Because the name holds all of Krishna's energies, namabhasa can give dharma, artha, kama and moksa, and even brought Ajamila close to Vaikuntha. It is the resort of all helpless souls. — “Even Nama Bhash is a resort for all helpless souls.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:27 (auto-transcript): “So by chanting Namabhas, one can attain the goals of dharma-artha-kam-moksh. One can get material happiness. Therefore, it is the resort for all helpless souls in this world. Even Nama Bhash is a resort for all helpless souls.”

Maharaj takes SB 6.2.14, which lists four ways the name may be chanted: indirectly (sanketya), jokingly (parihasya), as musical entertainment or derision (stobha) and neglectfully (helana). He also refers to Bhaktivinoda Thakura's Jaiva Dharma.

This verse glorifies the power of the name and encourages us to take shelter in any condition; it does not permit careless chanting. A near goal encourages where a distant one discourages. — “This is not a license for us to chant in Naam Abhas.”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:37 (auto-transcript): “This is not a license for us to chant in Naam Abhas. But this is a glorification of the power of the Holy Nib. It is an encouragement for us to take the shelter of the Holy Name in all respect, in any situation, in any condition of life.”

Sanketa means chanting with a material idea or by accident while meaning something else, like Ajamila calling his son, or a Muslim saying 'haram' and so saying 'Rama'.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:54 (auto-transcript): “Chanting in Sanketa or indirectly, means that one chant the name of Vishnu or Krishna with a specific material conception. Or chant the holy name unintentionally while thinking of some other objects with the same sound.”

Those who mocked the Lord's names still benefited; Jarasandha is given for jest and Sisupala for derision. These, without faith in Krishna, lie on the lower border of namabhasa.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:43 (auto-transcript): “Also, the Chankazi men who imitated the Holy Names, they also got affected by citing the Holy Names. Example of Parihasa is Jarasandha. Also the name is Toba or Derishan.”

Above them is chanting with some faith and shelter of the name while anarthas remain. Namabhasa itself cannot give prema, but by following sadhana under the guru one progresses to the pure name.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:15 (auto-transcript): “He won't change with genuine faith in Krishna and taking the shelter of the holy name while still in another church present. That state is called Shraddha, Shraddha, there is some fate, but not pure, but the fate, some fate is there, that is called Shraddha Nama Bhast.”

Since we are still under the clouds, this is a risky stage; we must be careful not to make offences, or namabhasa becomes namaparadha.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:21 (auto-transcript): “Namah Bhass is also good if we are very careful not to make enough friends while we are still on this stage we should be very careful not to make offence because we are still under the clouds so it's not clear therefore we are still on we're still on a risky stage therefore…”

A banyan seed is tiny, but planted it becomes a huge tree. Small offences repeated little by little grow the same way and uproot our devotion.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:25 (auto-transcript): “Banyan tree, the sea of Banyan tree is very small. But if you plant it, the banyan tree will become big. Therefore, if we continue to make offenses little by little by little by little, it will become big like a banyan tree and uproot the tree. So we should be careful we are…”

Mayavadis worship the Deity only as a means; after liberation, for them, there is no name, form or lila. We should avoid that association, and the desires for enjoyment and liberation.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:37 (auto-transcript): “We see that Mayavadis, they worship Deities. But they don't worship Krishna as the means and the end. They worship the deity of Krishna as already means. After attainment of pure or liberation, Deity is finished. No name, no lila, no qualities. But the Mayavadi people don't…”

Fixed in the position of Krishna's obedient servant, one chants constantly, tears come, and the name's sweetness and prema-bhakti appear.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:53 (auto-transcript): “And I set the position of being a servant of Krishna with obedience What obedience. For this mentality, when this mentality, one can constantly chant the holy name and tears will come to his eyes.”

When the guru's mercy gives knowledge of the name and sadhana dissipates ignorance and anarthas, namabhasa is transformed into the pure name, shining in full.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:40 (auto-transcript): “The full glory of the sun is not visible when covered by cloud. But when the clouds are removed, the sun shines in full glory. Just in this manner, when a person receives knowledge of the actual nature of the name by the mercy of the Guru, When the ignorance and anaratas”

Simply give up bad association and take shelter of Mahaprabhu's lotus feet; apart from his mercy there is no other way. — “There is no other way.”

🎙 Maharaj at 52:44 (auto-transcript): “To assert it in another way, one should simply give up bad association. And take shelter or look to his feet. Aller than Mahaprabhu's lotus feet. Yeshira Gurdjyayu. Aller than Mahaprabhu's lotus feet. Aller than his mercy. Unki krapa ke siwai. There is no other way. does…”

Maharaj has everyone repeat a prayer begging Haridasa Thakura for shelter at his lotus feet.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:21 (auto-transcript): “Everybody should repeat. Oh, Haridash Thakur, may you kindly give us shelter at your local's feet. Aap mujhe apne chan kamno ka ashraya dijiye. Amacha ja Haridash Thakur, ki jai. Ja. Comments. Kisi ka poitipadi ya prashna, devotees can raise your hand and ask question, if any.”

Questions from devotees (a sixth, at 77:57, gets the short answer that what is pure cannot be contaminated).

🎙 Maharaj at 54:54 (auto-transcript): “Comments. Kisi ka poitipadi ya prashna, devotees can raise your hand and ask question, if any. The first question was Shila Gurudev asked by, I think so, Bayarupa, Shama, Devi, Mataji, and then Brahmani and Krishna. Hare Krishna Maharaj, please accept my humble obeisances.…”

Is talking with neophyte devotees full of attachments also bad association?

🎙 Question from the floor at 55:25 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj, my question is, what is bad association? Like, there are some devotees who are very neophyte stage, and they have many material attachments. so if we speak to them and associate with them then it is also a bad association because with that association we will also…”

In every association we are either giving or taking. If we give Krishna consciousness we stay pure; if we take on materialistic consciousness we are contaminated. Check your consciousness. — “Either we are giving or we are taking.”

🎙 Maharaj at 56:43 (auto-transcript): “In every association, there are two things. Every association, two things are there. Either we are giving or we are taking. Therefore, we should check. are we giving or we are taking if we are taking then it is from if we are taking from materialistic people”

Neglectful chanting is an offence, yet helana is a kind of namabhasa; how do we tell them apart?

🎙 Question from the floor at 59:27 (auto-transcript): “So my question is in regards to the four divisions of Nama Bas, and I could perceive that it sounds a bit similar to the Nama Parada stage. My question is, how can we identify the difference between Nama Parada and Nama Bas, since some Offenses we commit while chanting the…”

Planning to break a principle and counteract it with chanting or ritual is aparadha. Calling out helplessly, as Ajamila called his son, is namabhasa. — “But in Nama Parade, we are intentionally doing.”

🎙 Maharaj at 61:15 (auto-transcript): “so the difference is that the difference is that the difference is that the difference between the two is that in namabhas in namabhas we are not making offenses like ajayimala chante But in Nama Parade, we are intentionally doing. So that is the difference.”

children.topic: Q3 · Relatives who mock the name?
children.note:
Family of other faiths insult the name; do they get the benefit of namabhasa?

🎙 Question from the floor at 64:25 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj, my question is for me we come from different faiths sometimes your family some of them will accept your faith and some of them will become very aggressive and violent and be insulting the holy name in the way that Hare Krishna people, they are other worshippers. And…”

🎙 Maharaj at 65:46 (auto-transcript): “This is not Nama Bahad, this is Nama Parad. So they will not get benefits. They are blaspheming the name. They don't know. If you ask them what is Adriwasi, they don't know what is Adriwasi. They were hardly saying it, and they were just foolishly saying it. So they are…”

The mind keeps wandering; how can attention be continuous?

🎙 Question from the floor at 67:06 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev, my question is that, as you said that, in attentive chanting is a naam aparad. So, when we chant, most of the time our mind distracts, most of the time we try to take our mind to naam, take it out in the now so this fight is going on and in between that in…”

children.topic: Chant more; the name finishes it
children.note:
Following the Padma Purana, keep chanting continuously, more than the fixed rounds, and try to control the mind. The name rises above the offences and uproots them. — “The name will do the remaining work.”

🎙 Maharaj at 68:29 (auto-transcript): “Padma Purana recommended to contract inattentive chanting. We should chant continuously and chant more than the surround. If we continue to chant, keep chanting, continue to chant and try to control the mind, Then the name will rise above the defenses and destroy it…”

children.note:
Thousands take prasadam in India; why so little change?

🎙 Question from the floor at 70:41 (auto-transcript): “thank you maharaj i have one question is that uh like in india especially uh when there's a distribution many people come in line thousands of people come in line and they would take Prasadam. But we do not see any much change in them. Prasadam has a potency, but they are not…”

Maharaj once followed a distribution party and learned the food had not been offered; many restaurants are the same, and cooks gossip while cooking. Prasadam is cooked in pure consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 71:47 (auto-transcript): “First of all, we should really disable prasada, we should disable the real prasada, means that the quality of the prasada may not match. Once I was in one temple, and I decided to follow the devotees for the Prasadhan distribution.”

Srila Prabhupada changed the world with prasadam: people took it and became devotees. Now we cook something else and see the effects.

maps.title: Harinama Cintamani · Session 05 · Offence #1 - Blaspheming the Devotees (Part 1)

nodeData.note: SB 11.11.29–32 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Chapter 4 begins the ten offences against the holy name, starting with blasphemy of devotees. Maharaj goes through Krishna's description of a sadhu's qualities, sets homework to tick our own, and stresses that the chief quality is surrender to Krishna — not birth, varna or asrama — so offending such a devotee is extremely dangerous. He draws on Mahaprabhu's instructions to Raghunatha dasa Gosvami about worldly talk, fancy food and fancy clothes, and answers questions on past blasphemy, surrender, family reactions, confessing envy and weddings. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
Chapter 4 begins the offences. Haridasa says they are ten according to scripture and one should be fearful of them.

🎙 Maharaj at 05:48 (auto-transcript): “Offenses to the holy name are analysed as ten, according to scripture. One should be fearful of these offences. One of the qualities we see in the pure devotees' life is that”

Maharaj notes that a mark of pure devotees is how careful they are about offences; to approach perfection in chanting we must be just as careful.

🎙 Maharaj at 06:21 (auto-transcript): “One of the qualities we see in the pure devotees' life is that they are very, very, very careful about committing the fences of Vaishnava. So for us to attempt perfection and chanting, we should carefully avoid these offenses.”

Criticising Vaishnavas; thinking demigods like Siva or Brahma independent of Krishna; disobeying the guru; disrespecting scripture; interpreting the name; sinning on its strength; giving it to the faithless; equating it with pious ritual; inattention; and clinging to I and mine despite knowing its glories.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:45 (auto-transcript): “One, to blaspheme or criticize Vaishnavas. Two, to consider that other living entities such as Bemi God are independent of Krishna. Even though they may be very, very powerful like Lord Shiva or Brahma. 3. To Disobey or Disrespect a Guru.”

Criticism of Vaishnavas is very dangerous for one wanting progress. To know whom not to offend, Maharaj goes through Krishna's list of a sadhu's qualities given to Uddhava in the Eleventh Canto: merciful, tolerant, equal to all, and more.

Austerity should not harm the body; any austerity that weakens our service or japa is demonic, not the divine tapas Rsabhadeva recommends. — “Means that auxerlity will give a strength to do better service.”

🎙 Maharaj at 14:27 (auto-transcript): “Means that auxerlity will give a strength to do better service. Any austerity which is performed that affects our services, affects our japa, it is demonic austerity, not tapu divyam, as recommended by Laura Sade. When Lord Nityananda Prabhu was sent from Jaginalpuri to…”

Sent from Puri to Bengal, Nityananda Prabhu and his party had nothing to eat for three months, yet, as Vrindavana dasa Thakura describes, they grew stronger and could uproot trees like grass. That is divine austerity.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:04 (auto-transcript): “When Lord Nityananda Prabhu was sent from Jaginalpuri to Bangalore, he did not be for three months. when Bhagavan Nityananda Prabhu brought the Bhagavan Chaitanya Mahaprabhu to the world to the world to the Bangladesh to the world Bhagavan Nityananda Prabhu and his sanghiya…”

Maharaj asks everyone, after class, to write the sadhu's qualities on paper and tick the ones they already have. — “Tick which one we have already”

🎙 Maharaj at 27:01 (auto-transcript): “you can do some homework who can write all these qualities in a paper. Who should write all these qualities in a paper.”

Pure love of God has no measure, but those practising it should measure where they stand if they want to advance. — “should measure where we are”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:40 (auto-transcript): “If we want to make advancement in Krishna consciousness, then we should measure where we are. Pure love of God does not have measure, it's unlimited. Pure devotional service, pure Christian consciousness has no measure, it's unlimited. But we practicing it should measure…”

Of all the qualities, the principal one is exclusive surrender to Krishna; the rest are its ornaments.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:21 (auto-transcript): “Of all these qualities, the cheap one is exclusive surrender to Krishna. So it is already shared and it is already shared so you can look at it later and do your homework and look at it later.”

Many of these good qualities are also found in impersonalists; the real test is how surrendered we are to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:24 (auto-transcript): “These qualities you will also see them not only in the pure sadhus you can also see them in the Mayabadi piece. Therefore, the cheap quality is how much surrender to Krishna are we. Bhagawan Shri Krishna Ki.”
What makes Krishna consciousness difficult is that we do not give ourselves to Krishna and the sadhus; we want them to deal with us as we like. — “That makes Krishna consciousness difficult.”

Maharaj quizzes the audience on Prabhupada's point: mercy, cleanliness, truthfulness and austerity are the four legs of religion, and lacking them makes surrender hard.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:06 (auto-transcript): “Srila Prabhupada said, to surrender to Krishna is not easy. And he gave the reason why or what makes surrender difficult. Fourteen Prabhupada said, and they are the four legs of religion. One, the four legs of religion.”

A sadhu has these qualities fully, so offending or disobeying such a person destroys our bhakti. — “Therefore, to offence such a person, it is extremely dangerous.”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:48 (auto-transcript): “A sadhu has these qualities completely. Therefore, to offence such a person, it is extremely dangerous. To disobey him or her is also very dangerous. how dangerous it is to destroy our bhakti”

The damage can reach generations of one's family, so it must be carefully avoided.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:23 (auto-transcript): “how dangerous it is to destroy our bhakti it will affect generations of our family members therefore it should be carefully avoided By some good fortune, one may get association of Vaishnavas and then attain a taste with the name, chant the name and take short of your…”

children.topic: Qualities come by chanting — and effort
children.note:
Through continuous chanting and avoiding offences all these qualities appear in a true Vaishnava.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:54 (auto-transcript): “All these qualities will become manifest in a body of a person who continuously chants the holy name and carefully avoids the offences. So we just wait for this quality to develop or we should do something.”

Should we simply wait for them? Waiting takes a long time; we should also make effort to correct our bad qualities, and then good ones develop easily. — “If we wait, it will take a long time.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:25 (auto-transcript): “So we just wait for this quality to develop or we should do something. If we wait, it will take a long time.”

Being grhastha, brahmacari, vanaprastha or sannyasi, sudra or brahmana, are external marks. A sudra may be a pure devotee while a sannyasi in saffron does nonsense. What counts is surrender to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:30 (auto-transcript): “Very important point. A sudra or vaishya or satriya may become a pure devotee, pure sadhu, not, or why the Sanyasi is still hanging there with his dress and doing nonsense.”

To open our eyes the Lord sends Haridasa to a Yavana family, Prahlada to a demonic one, Hanuman to an animal form, and Rupa Gosvami to work under rulers, then makes them Gosvamis.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:57 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, Chaitanya Mahaprabhu to teach us to open our eyes is to send Harita Sekhura to Yavana family. He sent Prahalad Maharaj to a demonic family. He sent Hanuman to animal family. He sent Santa Rupa Goswami”

Prahlada offers obeisances to devotees in all universes and species, since he cannot know who is a sadhu.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:38 (auto-transcript): “In different universities, in different planetary systems, in different species of life, Pralad offers obeisances to all of them. Because I don't know who is a sadhu. They may be in different universities, they may be in different planetary systems, they may be in different…”

Through Raghunatha dasa Gosvami the Lord teaches householders: live in family life with the mind fixed on service, not sense pleasure. Internally always fix on Krishna, externally follow one's social role; Maharaj repeats it so it goes into our heads.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:07 (auto-transcript): “The married man should enter household life with a mind steadily fixed on service to Krishna, not enamored by saint's gratification. And in this way, the householder can gradually cause the personal material existence. One should always be internally fixed on Krishna, though…”

For his renounced life the instruction was: neither hear nor speak worldly talk.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:11 (auto-transcript): “One should neither listen to materialistic conversation nor speak materialistic optics or orders. We should not listen, we should not speak it. one should not eat fancy food or wear fancy clothes if one eat”

No fancy food. Maharaj quizzes the room: after a rich feast comes sleep, then a disturbed mind, then one unwanted thing after another.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:44 (auto-transcript): “one should not eat fancy food or wear fancy clothes if one eat fancy food what will happen after that what happens after fancy food is eaten what happens If there is a lot of chadpada and swadhishth bhujan feast, what will happen? What will happen? What will happen with this…”

After fancy clothes comes the thought 'I am better than you'; false ego fills the heart and we think only of the body and bodily relations.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:17 (auto-transcript): “Even wear a fancy cloth. What happens after that? What happens after that? After a fancy cloth? Very good. Yes. Bright. I am better than all of you. Naturally, it will come to the mind. If the mind will be overtaken by false ego, the mind is overtaken by false ego, by pride.…”

He asks why, knowing all this, we don't act on it — an uncontrolled mind; we know it only intellectually. — “we know this thing, but why don't do it?”

🎙 Maharaj at 52:48 (auto-transcript): “we know this thing, but why don't do it? Why we don't do it? What will we all pray to all these things? One, all of God knows that. So I touched you. You're all serious. Uncontrolled mind. We don't have much more. actually it is our it is just we don't know it but we are…”

Questions from devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:05 (auto-transcript): “Sorry. Okay, let's take a break. Any comment or question before we move forward? Thank you. Thank you very much, Shila Gurudev. Devotees can ask questions or have any comments. Hashan Prabhuji, you can unmute yourself, ask your question. And then we have Dayarupa Shriyama…”

children.topic: Q1 · Blasphemy before becoming a devotee?
children.note:
Does blasphemy done before coming to Krishna consciousness still affect one and one's family?

🎙 Question from the floor at 57:00 (auto-transcript): “you said that if somebody blasphemy about it will be suffered and it will even go to his generations so so my question is that this person he didn't know Krishna consciousness and he was doing that so if this person become a devotee and see the light does it still going to…”

Prabhupada's example: fire burns a child who touches it; ignorance is no excuse. But as we progress Krishna erases it, and a devotee child releases generations of forefathers. — “The nature of the fire is that it will burn.”

🎙 Maharaj at 58:10 (auto-transcript): “So Prabhupada said, if a child touches fire, the fire will not say, this child is ignorant of me. The fire will not say that. The nature of the fire is that it will burn. Similarly, if we commit or do all these sins and ignorance, it is not an excuse. We will pray for them.”

How to surrender, and how to know we are surrendering?

🎙 Question from the floor at 61:31 (auto-transcript): “for that my question is how to surrender to krishna and how we will understand that we are we have surrendered or surrendering every day to krishna how we will understand that Surrounda means I will give myself to somebody. I will give myself to somebody. So I don't have…”

Surrender means giving oneself. Prabhupada's BG 18.66 purport gives six parts from Hari-bhakti-vilasa; the first two, accepting the favourable and rejecting the unfavourable, are where most of us still struggle with regulative principles and rounds.

children.topic: Q3 · Family offences fall on me?
children.note:
If family members offend pure devotees, will I suffer too?

🎙 Question from the floor at 68:00 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj I wanted to ask that though we are very I am trying to be careful of not making offences but as you said that if family members are also making offences against a pure devotee then generations will suffer so I am the very near generation so without my doing anything…”

If your family left you a thousand acres you would gladly sign. In the same way we share their reactions, good and bad. — “So, we will take the good and the bad.”

🎙 Maharaj at 69:21 (auto-transcript): “when they will leave big money for you in that family, would you not accept it? Would you say that, no, no, I am just in this family, I am not accepted? When they leave big money in that family, Will I save this or not? Yes. They say, well, Millar Devi, we have this 1,000…”

children.topic: Q4 · Should I confess past envy?
children.note:
Is envy itself an offence, and should one tell the devotee one envied?

🎙 Question from the floor at 75:43 (auto-transcript): “My question is, is envying another devotee, having envy towards another devotee, is an offense in itself? Because you once said that when we are envying someone, we wish the person was dead. that like is we want actually we want the person to die that's the meaning of having…”

Envy is very dangerous, a heavy anartha. It is good to tell the person, I am sorry, please forgive me; done sincerely, the person softens and forgives. — “It's good to do that.”

🎙 Maharaj at 77:24 (auto-transcript): “Yes, envy is very dangerous. Asia is very dangerous, yes. Very, very dangerous. Very dangerous. So, yeah, it's a heavy contamination.”

children.topic: Q5 · Fancy dress at family weddings?
children.note:
How to keep detachment when a sibling's wedding requires finery?

🎙 Question from the floor at 80:24 (auto-transcript): “Shri Gurudev, my question is that after coming to Krishna consciousness, we avoid going in marriages outside, but if marriage happens in our home, like of our siblings, then we have to wear fancy clothes, jewelries and everything. So how to develop Bairag for that, that if it…”

Lord Siva came to his wedding in a skin with ghostly companions, shocking his in-laws. Maharaj says you may dress up to please your family, then return to normal Vaishnava ways — just don't pray for a wedding every day.

🎙 Maharaj at 82:40 (auto-transcript): “Sorry, when Lord Shiva was going to do his wedding, he didn't wear any fancy clothes. When Bhagawan Shiva was going to his house, he didn't wear any fancy clothes. He put on his idea skin. He wore clothes on the bed.”

maps.title: Harinama Cintamani · Session 06 · Offence #1 - Blaspheming the Devotees (Part 2)

nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj completes the first offence: a sadhu is known by his surrender to Krishna, and traces of past faults are no reason to criticise him, since bhakti itself is received only through such Vaishnavas. He names four roots of blasphemy — birth, past sins, accidental slips and remaining traces — and warns against association that breeds disrespect, before answering questions on weakness, toxic company and food. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: Two kinds of qualities in a sadhu
children.note:
Continuing the first offence, Maharaj reads Haridasa Thakura's point that a sadhu has a primary characteristic and secondary ones. The primary one is his surrender to Krishna, and it covers everything else.

🎙 Maharaj at 06:43 (auto-transcript): “The qualities of a sadhu, he said, there are two types. One is secondary and one is primary. The primary one is our level of surrender to Krishna. He covers all other. Bhakta hote hain, jinkai doopsthatya dunh hote hain. Ek hota hai Svarubalakchana, ek hota hai…”

The svarupa-laksana, the essential sign of a devotee, is that he has taken full shelter of Krishna. Secondary signs vary with varna and ashrama and are called tatastha-laksana.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:02 (auto-transcript): “The primary one is our level of surrender to Krishna. He covers all other. Bhakta hote hain, jinkai doopsthatya dunh hote hain. Ek hota hai Svarubalakchana, ek hota hai Tatasthalakchana. So Svarubalakchana hai, voh ya hai ki Bhakta ka sabse mahanaguni ya hai, kusne Bhagawan…”

children.topic: A fault does not cancel him
children.note: Even if some fault appears in a person, if he has the chief quality of surrender he is still to be considered a sadhu and respected. Maharaj cites Krishna's words in the Gita that such a person is to be counted a sadhu because he is properly situated.

children.topic: Old traces vanish by the name
children.note:
Remnants of past sins may still show for a while, but the holy name removes them quickly. To criticise a sadhu for such traces is sadhu-ninda and brings Krishna's displeasure.

🎙 Maharaj at 10:59 (auto-transcript): “Sometimes remnants of those sins may still remain, but they will completely vanish by the influence of the Holy Name. So it is possible that there are a few senses of the whole life that can be done with us, but with the power of the name of God, all the senses and faith are…”

Maharaj calls this a very important comment: we must always be careful not to slip into judging devotees. — “Not to have the mentality of being judgmental.”

🎙 Maharaj at 13:59 (auto-transcript): “It means that we should always be cautious, we should always be careful. Not to have the mentality of being judgmental. And at the same time, it does not also make us fools.”

At the same time this teaching does not make us fools who call everybody a sadhu; discrimination is still needed. — “That is just for foolishness.”

🎙 Maharaj at 14:41 (auto-transcript): “And at the same time, it does not also make us fools. So those things, everybody has become sadhu. I don't want to make a thing, then everybody is sadhu. That is just for foolishness. If we are very, very sincere in our practice, Krishna will always guide us, so we don't”

If we are sincere in our practice, Krishna guides us so that we neither offend real devotees nor take shelter of the wrong person.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:13 (auto-transcript): “If we are very, very sincere in our practice, Krishna will always guide us, so we don't make mistakes to make our friends or to save a wrong personal side. One who is making advancement according to Vabgita, chapter 4, is glorifying the process of bhakti.”

children.topic: The fire of bhakti burns the rest
children.note: Maharaj points to the Gita's fourth chapter: one who sits in the boat of transcendental knowledge crosses over even if he was most sinful. In the same way the fire of bhakti and the power of the name burn off the remaining traces of sin in due course.

Only one fully devoted to Krishna and sincerely chanting his name is counted a sadhu in this sense. Maharaj asks how many people in the whole world even avoid grains on Ekadasi — very few.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:20 (auto-transcript): “One who is devoted to Krishna fully and sings Krishna's name sincerely says, Rather than the devotees of Krishna, no one else is considered a sadha.”

Haridasa Thakura says that even a person of poor qualities who chants the holy name is to be respected as a Vaishnava.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:21 (auto-transcript): “If a person of their poor qualities Chant the holy name Even once He is considered a voice number And should be respected If Vaishnava is a friend and spiritual leader of the universe, he is an ocean of mercy to all living entities.”

A Vaishnava is a friend of the whole world and an ocean of mercy to every living being. Whoever blasphemes him goes to hell, because there is no liberation higher than bhakti and bhakti is received only by a Vaishnava's mercy.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:50 (auto-transcript): “If Vaishnava is a friend and spiritual leader of the universe, he is an ocean of mercy to all living entities. Guru hota hai. Vah Sampoon Jagat ka Mitra hota hai. Pratek Jeeva ke liye Krapa ka Sagar hota hai.”

Maharaj asks whether bhakti is for sale in the market — perhaps an online market? No; it is given only by a Vaishnava.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:52 (auto-transcript): “Jho aise Vaisnava ki ninda can we get bhakti in the market. Online. Online market. Bhakti is given by Vaishnava. Yes.”

The hladini and samvit energies reside in the pure devotee, so by contact with him one can also receive devotion to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:39 (auto-transcript): “In the pure Vaishnava, in the pure Vaishnava recite Krishna's energy of bhakti. Ladini and Samvit, two elegy reside in the body of the pure Vaishnava. Those by contacting a Vaishnava, one can also receive Krishna Bhakti. So powerful, Vaishnava, Vaishnava who has bhakti, so…”

So powerful is such a Vaishnava that his food remnants, the water from his feet and the dust of his feet create bhakti. If he can purify us so much, Maharaj asks, how dangerous it is to criticise him.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:19 (auto-transcript): “So powerful, Vaishnava, Vaishnava who has bhakti, so powerful that even the food remnant, the water that washes his lotus feet and the dust from his feet are a very powerful article for creating bhakti. ki vayshuna ka uchhiste, uska juthan, uske dwarah piyya gaya koyi bhi…”

children.topic: The breeze from a pure devotee
children.note:
Just staying near a pure devotee for some time, one receives the energy of bhakti flowing from him.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:34 (auto-transcript): “If one stays near a pure voice Just to stay near Near pure voice for some time One can receive the bhakti energy Flowing from his body When Janak Maharaj passed through the gate of hell, just passing through the gate of hell,”

children.topic: Janaka at the gate of hell
children.note:
Maharaj tells how a great king only passed by the gate of hell, and the breeze from his body relieved those inside. They begged him to stay a few minutes more, and he waited for them, though he was told to leave them to pay for their deeds.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:47 (auto-transcript): “When Janak Maharaj passed through the gate of hell, just passing through the gate of hell, the breeze from his body entered the head”

We are advised that even if a sadhu does not speak to us, we should sit near him and listen to what he discusses — that way we get everything. — “You get everything.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:36 (auto-transcript): “We have been advised that even if Sadhu or Vajra didn't talk to you, just sit down near them and hear what they are talking. Even if they are talking to you, just sit down with them and hear what they are discussing. You get everything.”

Maharaj asks what makes us criticise a devotee, and lists four things: birth, past sins, accidental faults, and remaining traces of old sin.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:25 (auto-transcript): “What makes you criticize or bless him? What makes you do that? Four things a day.”

We look at a devotee's birth: this one black, that one white, this one mixed. Bhakti does not depend on any of these things — one hundred percent.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:11 (auto-transcript): “We look at voice hours according to the Akats. What is the Akats by the birth? This one. Black man. Yeh kala hai, it's white. Yeh gora hai. This one, mixed. Yeh mila hua hai, kala bhiya gora bhiya hai. Bhakti does not depend on these things, 100%. Bhakti does not depend on…”

From Srila Prabhupada: two people without a common language live together and the house catches fire — how do they help each other? The audience suggests cries and hand signs; Maharaj adds Prabhupada's story of a British shopkeeper and his Bengali worker who could only explain a monkey's mess by acting it out. If you refuse your neighbour's help because he is not of your tribe, you suffer.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:20 (auto-transcript): “this you are Prabhupada gave an example in a lecture and also in a book Prabhupada gives us in a lecture we have studied two persons are living together they don't understand each other's language and the house is on fire how will you communicate with the other person to help…”

Most of us are a small minority of devotees in our own community. Can we be sure there is a pure devotee from our own group to save us? Krishna consciousness does not depend on externals. — “We are minorities in Krishna Consciousness.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:53 (auto-transcript): “For most of us, for majority of us, we are minorities in Krishna Consciousness. We are minorities in Krishna Consciousness. Maybe your tribe, maybe your tribe, only 10 people are devotees. So are you sure that you have one pure devotee that is going to save you?”

We also capitalise on a person's past faults, on unpremeditated accidental mistakes, and on traces of old sin. One fixed steadily in practice will surely become a pure devotee, so we should not seize on little things done by mistake.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:39 (auto-transcript): “So that is one. Second thing, second thing we use to make our friends, we look at the previous sin or faults in one's life, the fault a person having from previous life activities which we're discussing. We capitalize on someone's faults or sinful acts. The third thing is I…”

We need to be careful how we relate with one another; our real security is strict shelter of the holy name. — “how we are relating with each other.”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:12 (auto-transcript): “we need to be careful how we are relating with each other. Our security is that, our security is that one who strictly takes shelter for the holy name will not make my sava palat.”

Haridasa Thakura warns that association with non-devotees inevitably produces disrespect for devotees, so materialistic company must be carefully avoided.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:15 (auto-transcript): “Association with those who are not devotees is bound to produce disrespect for devotees. Sadhu Ninda. Association where those who are not devotees will surely produce disrespect for devotees. Sadhu Ninda. Therefore, materialistic association, it should be carefully avoided.…”

This means association outside scriptural limits: outside marriage for sense enjoyment, or within marriage where one is controlled by one's wife.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:58 (auto-transcript): “Association with women means associating with women not according to Vedic tradition. This association with women that is not authorized by scripture is divided into two associations”

Association with non-devotees is of three types, all very dangerous: impersonalists, pretenders and atheists.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:13 (auto-transcript): “The association with non-devotees is of three types. association with Mayavadis association with pretenders and association with atheist”

To progress to prema one must distinguish devotee from non-devotee, and also grades among Vaishnavas: the beginner with faith but no service attitude to sadhus, the middle devotee who honours the Lord's devotees, and the topmost who sees Krishna everywhere and simply relishes the name.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:04 (auto-transcript): “according to their spiritual advancement. The materialistic Vaisava or Vaisava Praya is he who has Madhyaoka faith in Krishna but has no service attitude to Sadhus. The higher stage of Vajshava is a Madhyam Bhakt who can recognize the important position of the Lord's devotees…”

The chapter closes: one who, like a bumblebee, clings to Haridasa Thakura's lotus feet receives the touchstone of the name. If we want the pure name, Maharaj says, we must beg for it there.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:48 (auto-transcript): “That person who, like bumblebee, Lingas are the lotus feet of Haridash. Yes, yes. He will receive the toe stone of the holy name as his life and soul.”

Devotees ask about weakness in sadhana, toxic company, who counts as a sadhu, unavoidable association and food cooked by non-devotees. A question on offences to the guru is kept for that chapter.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:44 (auto-transcript): “you may unmute yourself and ask your question and then I want to ask, I am very low in bhakti and I want to become, I can't become like you But 0.00001% if I can become like you, that would be the achievement.”

A devotee confesses she cannot even keep up sixteen rounds and asks how to rise.

🎙 Question from the floor at 53:54 (auto-transcript): “I want to ask, I am very low in bhakti and I want to become, I can't become like you But 0.00001% if I can become like you, that would be the achievement. So how should I do means including everything, excuses, health issues, including everything.”

children.topic: Beg from one who has it
children.note:
If you lack something, you beg from the person who has it — that is the process. When she asks him for bhakti, Maharaj jokes that he will register her application. — “I will register your application.”

🎙 Maharaj at 55:28 (auto-transcript): “Maybe you can beg, if you don't have something, you beg the person who has it, that's the process, right?”

children.topic: Q2 · Toxic people we cannot avoid
children.note:
What to do when we are weak and surrounded by negative friends or family?

🎙 Question from the floor at 60:54 (auto-transcript): “But when we are weak in our bhakti and around us, the people like in a college or in a house or very near person who is very toxic, how we can deal with the toxicity? How we can deal with this negative friends or family whom we couldn't avoid? and we couldn't give them…”

Chant and pray in a secluded place until you are strong, and don't sit with them more than needed. If you enjoy that association Krishna leaves you there; if you pray sincerely he finds a way to release you. — “If you are enjoying that association, Krishna will leave you there.”

🎙 Maharaj at 63:25 (auto-transcript): “We have to find a way to protect ourselves. or should try not always to sit with them because there is nothing in common.”

children.topic: Q3 · Must a sadhu be pure?
children.note:
Can we too drink the foot-water of a strict follower of Rupa Gosvami, and must a sadhu be a pure devotee or simply a senior one?

🎙 Question from the floor at 65:53 (auto-transcript): “Gurudev I had two questions like firstly you said in between that anyone who is following very strictly the rules given by Sheila Rupa Goswami they should like wash the lotus feet and drink the like the remnants so Gurudev my question was that can we also do that or like if…”

It is the qualities that make a sadhu — surrender and great care to avoid offences — not age or years in the movement. And the foot-water instruction applies to everyone who finds such a person. — “It's a rule for all.”

🎙 Maharaj at 68:03 (auto-transcript): “Sadhu should have the qualities we mentioned, not those, someone who has been in a movement for one million years, is the qualities that makes one a sadhu, not age, not how many years, but the qualities. Harada Secura mentioned one who is one who is surrender to Krishna and…”

Householders, preachers and students must mix with non-devotees; can one stay unaffected?

🎙 Question from the floor at 71:09 (auto-transcript): “my first you told to avoid materialistic association but in Grahasta Ashram some way or the other will have to associate with them like while preaching also devotees have to associate with non-devotees or a student in school also have to do so so what should be done in this…”

Either we take their negative energy or, if we are strong, we give them Krishna consciousness. — “There is nothing like being neutral.”

🎙 Maharaj at 72:26 (auto-transcript): “There is nothing like being neutral. I am associating, but I am not taking negativity from others. There is nothing like that.”

Going out to preach is going to a battlefield: chant your rounds, hear and reflect first, and stay alert. Maya can attack even alone in your room through a mobile phone; our protection is how surrendered we are and crying to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 73:34 (auto-transcript): “So while we are going to preach to people, we should know we are going on a battlefield, we are going to fight. You are going to fight, so you are well equipped.”

Quoting the Caitanya-caritamrta on food from materialists, a devotee asks how strict we should be.

🎙 Question from the floor at 82:30 (auto-transcript): “Last lecture, your holiness was discussing about one should not eat fancy food, but Chitani Mahaprabhu says in Chitani Chachamrit, Antalila 6, 278, quote, when one eats food offered by a materialistic man, the worst man becomes contaminated. When the man is contaminated, one…”

Food carries the cook's consciousness, so devotees avoid food not prepared by devotees and offered to Krishna. Maharaj recalls a great babaji who refused to speak to his servant for eating festival food from a man of questionable character.

🎙 Maharaj at 84:03 (auto-transcript): “Yes, it is already said that we should not eat food from, we not take food, not eat food cooked by nandigotis because your contaminated consciousness is inside food. So, we become also affected by their consciousness.”

maps.title: Harinama Cintamani · Session 07 · Offence #2 - Independent Demigod Worship

nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj takes up the second offence: thinking the demigods equal to or independent of Vishnu. He explains the graded qualities of Krishna, Vishnu, Shiva and the jivas, the householder's way of honouring demigods with Krishna's prasada, and why denying the Lord's name, form and qualities is the impersonalists' envy — then answers questions on 'all names are one', family worship of Shiva and empowered souls. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note:
After the first offence, blaspheming devotees, Haridasa Thakura turns to the second: considering demigods such as Brahma and Shiva equal to Vishnu or independent of him. However powerful they are, they are neither.

🎙 Maharaj at 01:54 (auto-transcript): “Let's continue our reading from Shri Hainam Chintamani. So Haridasa Kura is a turn of fences. We have looked at my one note to Blasem, Vaishnavas were dedicated to forgetting the holy name of Krishna. And the second one.”

Haridasa Thakura speaks very humbly. Maharaj explains that a real representative does not speak because he knows; whatever he says is dictated and directed by the Lord.

🎙 Maharaj at 05:50 (auto-transcript): “Kharidash Thakur is speaking with humility. Shilhaidash Thakur ji atyant binamrabhav mein bol raha hai. He is not speaking because he knows. Ish liye nahin bol raha hai. He is speaking because he knows that the Lord is speaking to you. In the real sense of things, this is a…”

Maharaj recalls the author of Prema-vilasa telling readers: if you find a mistake in my narration, it is not mine — it comes from the master who ordered me, and I had no strength to refuse him. — “The fault is coming from a master who asked me to do this.”

🎙 Maharaj at 06:50 (auto-transcript): “The devotee Nityananda Prabhu is the one who who composed Prem Vilaas, Prem Vilaas, Prem Vilaas.”

So Haridasa first clarifies the position of Vishnu, to show that what the pure devotee writes comes from a source that cannot err. One who sees faults in a pure devotee's writings is himself at fault.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:55 (auto-transcript): “Now Haridas is going to, first of all, clarify the positional issue. First of all, we are going to show the Bhagavan Vishnu's Paramtattwa, Shila Haidash Thakur, Vishnu Tattwa, about Vishnu Tattwa.”

children.topic: Vishnu, lord of the three modes
children.note:
Vishnu is the supreme principle, full of consciousness and knowledge, beyond material nature though its absolute controller.

🎙 Maharaj at 11:10 (auto-transcript): “Brother Sikura said, Vishnu is a supreme principle, not subject to the quality of the material world. First sentence. Vishnu is a form full of consciousness and knowledge existing internally beyond the mood of the material nature, although being the absolute control of the…”

children.note:

maps.title: Harinama Cintamani · Session 08 · Offence #3 - Disobeying the Guru

nodeData.note: · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj presents the third offence, disregarding the guru. The human body is the boat, the scriptures the breeze and the guru the captain, so taking a guru is compulsory; Haridasa Thakura explains a guru's real qualification, the diksa and siksa gurus, how to serve and honour him, and when either side must reject the other. Questions cover ISKCON's protection under Srila Prabhupada, the strength to obey and how the guru gives faith. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: The third offence: disregarding the guru
children.note:
Having covered blaspheming devotees and treating demigods as independent of Vishnu, Haridasa Thakura, the namacarya, now teaches the danger of disregarding, disrespecting and disobeying the guru.
